name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Ladder.ladder_collapse
title: Key-switching ladders collapse: the output is a noisy sample of the last secret on a public matrix
statement: Let G G^{-1}(X) = X for all X. Let the hints be K_i = s_{i+1}^T B_{i+1} + e_i - s_i^T G, the public matrices M_{i+1} = B_{i+1} G^{-1}(M_i), the ladder values y_{i+1} = y_i + K_i G^{-1}(M_i) + r_i (r_i an arbitrary perturbation such as a rounding error) and the errors eps_{i+1} = eps_i + e_i G^{-1}(M_i) + r_i. If y_0 = s_0^T M_0 + eps_0 then y_i = s_i^T M_i + eps_i for every i.
